manual_validation_checklist: Compile locally with C++20 and -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic (add the external library named in the solution when applicable).

Use a steady clock and verify the result. A single timing is illustrative only; repeat runs, control the environment and compare equivalent work.
Keep this solution in repository-only protected content; do not include it in learner API responses.
